# hiok_vm_network_rule (Resource)

A firewall or routing rule on a virtual machine.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)
- `vm_name` (String) The VM's name.

### Optional

- `action` (String) Allow or Deny.
- `description` (String)
- `destination` (String) CIDR or *.
- `direction` (String) Inbound or Outbound.
- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `gateway` (String) Next hop, for route rules.
- `port_range` (String) e.g. 22, 80-443 or *.
- `priority` (Number) Lower runs first (100-4096).
- `protocol` (String) TCP, UDP, ICMP or Any.
- `rule_type` (String) inbound, outbound or route.
- `source` (String) CIDR or *.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
